facts.text: I'm Arthur, I'm rich, and I'm having a lovely time. Hobson, bring the car around, and bring a sandwich.
facts.why: Not an Arthur line. The quote page has 'I'm going to take a bath.' and 'No, I have remained drunk since our last encounter.' Printed in quote marks and signed Arthur Bach.

facts.why: The word penthouse is nowhere in the transcript or plot; the Bach family has a house and estate.

facts.text: Arthur's usual, Hobson pouring with a sigh.
facts.why: Arthur says he is drinking Scotch and later orders a glass of scotch, so scotch as his usual drink is shown; Hobson looking after him is the film's running joke.
Nothing in the transcript shows Arthur drinking champagne or a Kir royale, so tying it to him is unproven; the cocktail itself can stay as a plain menu item.
